purpose: Check reference identity independently of predicted boxes, in addition to archived visual ground truth and the full annotation proxy.
input: After all R166 predictions are sealed. Each physical expression appears once in the panel. Select three annotation-eligible edges and three unresolved edges per target platform with a fixed hash order and recording round-robin. Do not use scores, predicted boxes or any performance outcome to select cases.
adjudication: Show the complete utterance, parsed reference phrase, RGB, the annotated target, and all available annotated other boxes. Hide method choices and proxy labels. Require independent text/image evidence for a single annotated reference. Keep absent, ambiguous and incorrect-parser cases in the audit diagram counts as unverifiable.
output: Separate descriptive visual-review table. Apply a verified physical reference label to both matching source directions using the same identity metric. Keep the six-direction macro and current locked primary proxy metrics unchanged. No model or evaluation settings are chosen from these cases. Original media, language, coordinates and annotation identifiers stay private.
